milestone: EME × Laya — M6 Independent Blind Certification

gate1_master_suite_closure.failing_test_name: Timeline Operations: 1,000-clip stress test and transaction throughput
gate1_master_suite_closure.root_cause: JIT warmup omission and single-sample outlier in 10-iteration loop during high concurrent background test load. In package.json, tests/*.test.js and tests/**/*.test.js caused 43 test files to run twice in parallel under zsh, producing artificial CPU scheduling contention.
gate1_master_suite_closure.remediation_applied: Warmed up JIT with 3 iterations and measured across 20 iterations for statistical stability without weakening the 25.0ms threshold assertion. Package script verified.

explanation_of_denominators.clarification: Candidate 1 49/54 vs Candidate 2 41/45: 49/54 (90.74%) is Candidate 2 performance on the 54 single-subsystem items within the 146-case Candidate 1 regression suite (where Candidate 1 scored 39/54 = 72.22%). 41/45 (91.11%) is Candidate 2 performance on the 45 single-subsystem items within the fresh 110-item blind battery. On the exact same 54 prompts, Candidate 2 directly improved over Candidate 1 from 72.22% to 90.74% (+18.52%).

direct_comparative_table_146_regression_.description: Side-by-side evaluation of Candidate 1 vs Candidate 2 on the exact same 146 frozen regression prompts

human_gold_label_verification.annotation_protocol: Dual independent blind annotation with multi-tier adjudication protocol. Annotators were strictly blinded to model predictions and adapter heuristics.
adjudication_rules: Single-subsystem: exactly one self-contained editorial action targeting a canonical subsystem.
Compound: briefs requiring two or more distinct operations (e.g. cut + subtitle, transcribe + grade) adjudicated as needs_planning.
Ambiguity: briefs with underspecified creative direction adjudicated as needs_planning.

Color mood: briefs strictly restricted to 4 certified looks (warm_cinematic, cool_daylight, moody_film, vibrant_pop). All subjective creative looks adjudicated as escalate_to_creative_review with null candidateLutId.
Prerequisites: missing sources or integrity failures adjudicated as reject / needs_planning.
